name: JW Marriott Scottsdale Camelback Inn Resort and Spa
positioning: Historic pueblo-style desert resort near Camelback Mountain in Paradise Valley, where Marriott inaugurated its JW brand, with casitas, suites with private pools, two championship golf courses and a desert-inspired spa
best_for: Golfers who want two championship courses at the resort
Travelers wanting casitas or suites with patios, mountain views or private pools
Families wanting a children's pool and on-site recreation

facts.text: The resort is near Camelback Mountain in Paradise Valley, Arizona.
The resort was designed by architect Edward Loomis Bowes.
The accommodations are pueblo-style and pet-friendly, with kitchenettes, and a select few have private pools.
Rooms have a balcony or private patio surrounded by gardens.
The spa has cabanas, and The Villa is an indoor-outdoor spa suite for small groups and special occasions.
The Padre Course was designed by golf course architect Arthur Hills.
The pool complex has private cabanas and daybeds with shade and attentive service.
On-site recreation includes a play area, half-court basketball, shuffleboard, a pitch and putt course, bicycles, tennis and pickleball.
The resort has two fitness centers and private and group classes.
Rita's Cantina and Bar serves Southwestern fare and has a large stone patio with views of Mummy Mountain.
The horticulture team leads tours on the native plants and flowers of the Sonoran Desert.

highlights.text: Marriott inaugurated its JW brand at this resort.
Early guests included Mrs. Dwight D. Eisenhower, Clark Gable, Jimmy Stewart, Bette Davis and J.W. Marriott, Sr.
Many of the suites have private pools and Arizona desert and mountain views.
Camelback Golf Club at the resort has 36 championship holes on two courses, Ambiente and Padre.
The Jackrabbit Pool Experience includes a children's pool, an adult pool and the Jackrabbit main pool.

considerations.text: Camelback Mountain is about a mile from the resort.
Scottsdale Fashion Square, with over 200 stores and dining choices, is a drive from the resort.
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is about 9 miles from the hotel.
